name: Kavah
description: A city where Oret was welcomed as a hero after executing Anafenza.

timeline.summary: Oret is honored in Kavah, then secretly gathers the amber shards and plants a new tree with Anafenza's name carved in it, erasing it from maps so her spirit has an anchor.
timeline.quote: It was to be Anafenza's tree.

pages_say.description: A city on the Salt Road where the caravan had just stopped.
A city where Oret was welcomed as a hero after executing Anafenza.
